messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — embeddings prod eu1 is spiking 5xxs, rolling a small hotfix image (runtime bump) and need an expedited pin + deploy window

aleks: @morgan what's the severity/impact? canary results?

morgan: impact ~2.4% embed failures across dedicated pool since 03:12 UTC, affecting async batch jobs and some low-latency calls. Canary ran functional checks but failed under sustained qps. Root cause: kv-cache race causing OOM on quant path; hotfix adds a guard + mem limit.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: service=embeddings target=eu1-prod image=redwood/embeddings:1.6.3-hotfix tag=v2.3.1-hotfix strategy=rolling canary=false owner=@morgan

tayla: we need a pin decision. options: pin to v2.3.1-hotfix globally for 30m (skip canary), or do a 2% canary then ramp. given visible customer impact, leaning expedite global pin. objections?

samir: I vote expedite pin global 30m. Monitoring+rollback criteria: error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> rollback. I'll own the watch.

aleks: :thumbsup: infra approves. please attach release notes and confirm rollback plan.

morgan: release notes: https://go/redwood/release/17321 — includes kvcache guard, mem-limit, and test notes. changelog entry posted in docs. rollback plan: revert image -> redwood/embeddings:1.6.2 and pin model to v2.3.0-q8 if needed.

releasebot: Releasebot: notes attached https://go/release/17321, changelog checksum: abc123

tayla: approved by release manager. @deploy-bot kick when ready. enable logging hooks and post-deploy smoke check.

deploy-bot: Starting deploy now: rolling to all eu1-prod. Canary skipped by owner flag. Post-deploy checks enabled (smoke, latency, 5xx).

samir: monitoring dashboards up, alerting to #eng-sre. I'll escalate and trigger rollback on criteria. I'm on-call for next 45m.

morgan: if we rollback, fallback is to pin model to quant variant v2.3.0-q8 in eu1 and reopen ticket #3456. Drafting status page notice.

tayla: :white_check_mark: manual go from product + ops. keep updates here.

samir: 15m post-deploy: error_rate ~0.3% -> trending down. latency stable. continuing 15m watch.

morgan: :thumbsup: keeping v2.3.1-hotfix pinned for 30m window. will unpin after stable window and cut a follow-up changelog note about rollback criteria.
